# This test checks that "bolero mod tidy -x" print
# commands tidy executes.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/35849

rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote
bolero mod tidy
! stderr 'get '$BOLERO_PROXY

rm $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote
bolero mod tidy -x
stderr 'get '$BOLERO_PROXY

-- go.mod --
module example.com/mod

-- a.go --
package mod
import _ "rsc.io/quote"
